issue17.title: HOST-004: draft bounded window receiver and incomplete-transfer evidence
issue17.body:
Dot B-owned follow-on to #10/PR15. Scope is receive-only host window assembly, not a full session or command engine. Pin unaccepted shared candidate124b3f32 until A clarifies; no independent protocol fork.

Predeclared acceptance: exact WINDOW_BEGIN40/DATA12+2N (1..250)/END16/ABORT12 lengths; enums/reserved/ADC0..4095 and stable expected session/generation/config/profile validation before bounded allocation; profile1 exactly2048 samples. Sequential offsets; exact previous block duplicates harmless, conflict/overlap/gap/changed IDs produces explicit incomplete outcome preserving verified fragments. Emit immutable success once only after2048 samples plus valid END count/CRC32 of4096 LE bytes. Abort/disconnect/reset/progress timeout yields incomplete fragments/missing ranges, never fabricated zero-fill or successful .mtcap.20 synthetic windows and negative cases through HOST002 framing with independently calculated expected samples/CRC.

New files only: host/motortester/window.py, host/tests/test_window.py, host/tests/test_window_conformance.py, host/tests/fixtures/window/**, host/docs/window-receive.md. No model/recording/GUI/firmware/shared protocol/CI edits. Preserve ambiguous external_edge_id raw and explicitly defer Auto+external semantic acceptance; TX sequence allocation belongs outside this seam. No USB/Windows/hardware claim. Independent Critic-B fixed-rubric exact-SHA gate required before acceptance; owner A retains merge authority.
